stories.title: Oxygen stations operating beyond capacity in Gaza
stories.summary: Oxygen stations operating beyond capacity in Gaza Gaza's health ministry has announced that the enclave's oxygen stations are operating beyond maximum capacity because Israel is preventing essential supplies from entering. The ministry said only 12 out of 34 oxygen stations remain operational. Only four out of 30 oxygen cylinders are still functioninf. "The availability of oxygen is not a medical luxury, but is the lifeline for many vital and life-saving departments," the ministry warned.
